references.text: Joel describes the locusts' destruction of the crops, reflecting the curse that locusts will devour what is sown.
Amos mentions locusts devouring gardens and vineyards, a parallel to the curse of failed harvests.
The plague of locusts in Egypt demonstrates God's power to send locusts that destroy crops, the same threat found in the curse.
Isaiah describes how ten acres of vineyard yield only one bat, illustrating the theme of sowing much but reaping little.
Solomon prays that God will hear when locusts come over the land and acknowledges this as a judgment.
